gameplay.interpretation: Qualitative gameplay feedback; no per-action counts, hardware fault injection or measured contact-to-HID latency. Hover not cured.

limits: Hover not cured; no new classifier or NVRAM table deployed.
Held ON with valid timely native status does not reread DIFF each frame.
No whole-chip 50ms release guarantee for another new lane group-DIFF failure.
50ms fault expiry is evaluated when processing resumes; no hard HID latency guarantee.
Host age is not chip scan age; separate BUTTON_STAT and DIFF are not guaranteed atomic.
No live MPR snapshot; FDL=255 comment is not verified hardware baseline disable.
Timing windows have uncontrolled posture; profile-off errors excluded from gate counter.
Gameplay feedback is qualitative, without counted trials or fault injection.
